briefdescription.para: Insert Point Analysis.
UseBlocks - Blocks where CurLI has uses.
NumGapBlocks - Number of duplicate entries in UseBlocks for blocks where the live range has a gap.
ThroughBlocks - Block numbers where CurLI is live through without uses.
NumThroughBlocks - Number of live-through blocks.
LooksLikeLoopIV - The variable defines what looks like it could be a loop IV, where it defs a variable in the latch.
analyzeUses - Count instructions, basic blocks, and loops using CurLI.
calcLiveBlockInfo - Compute per-block information about CurLI.

detaileddescription.para: calcLiveBlockInfo - Fill the LiveBlocks array with information about blocks where CurLI is live.

briefdescription.para: analyze - set CurLI to the specified interval, and analyze how it may be split.
clear - clear all data structures so SplitAnalysis is ready to analyze a new interval.
getParent - Return the last analyzed interval.
isOriginalEndpoint - Return true if the original live range was killed or (re-)defined at Idx.

detaileddescription.para: Idx should be the 'def' slot for a normal kill/def, and 'use' for an early-clobber def. This can be used to recognize code inserted by earlier live range splitting.

briefdescription.para: getUseSlots - Return an array of SlotIndexes of instructions using CurLI.

detaileddescription.para: This include both use and def operands, at most one entry per instruction.

briefdescription.para: getUseBlocks - Return an array of BlockInfo objects for the basic blocks where CurLI has uses.
getNumThroughBlocks - Return the number of through blocks.
isThroughBlock - Return true if CurLI is live through MBB without uses.
getThroughBlocks - Return the set of through blocks.
getNumLiveBlocks - Return the number of blocks where CurLI is live.
countLiveBlocks - Return the number of blocks where li is live.

detaileddescription.para: This is guaranteed to return the same number as getNumLiveBlocks() after calling analyze(li).

briefdescription.para: shouldSplitSingleBlock - Returns true if it would help to create a local live range for the instructions in BI.

detaileddescription.para: There is normally no benefit to creating a live range for a single instruction, but it does enable register class inflation if the instruction has a restricted register class.

parameterdescription.para: True when single instructions should be isolated.

briefdescription.para: SplitAnalysis - Analyze a LiveInterval, looking for live range splitting opportunities.
